headline: Thieves Steal Bronze Age Treasures in Brazen Spanish Museum Heist
context: Art theft experts say the heist at the Museum of Villena mimics increasingly violent and quick robberies elsewhere in Europe, possibly inspired by last year’s Louvre break-in.

sources.name: The New York Times
